dedupe_keys.name: joint research centre drought and low flow datasets

description: Joint Research Centre: drought and low-flow datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drought and low-flow; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Drought and surface water monitoring in Zambia’s Central and Southern ; Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) European Dataset for Drought Monitori; Drought events based on SPI 3 version 1.0; Drought events based on SPI 12 version 1.0. Formats seen: CSV, NETCDF, ZIP, TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
